decision_basis: Target tier 3 is not attainable. F-105 and the open gap g-1-household-survey leave e2-functional-use without admissible evidence bearing on the relationship, so the causal path from functional water points through household use to disease incidence cannot carry a tier-3 identification claim. Tier 2 gates all pass on the cited subgraph e1-rehab-functional, which is supported by an admissible maintenance log, an admissible UDID receipt, and an engine evaluation of impact.output.achieved returning verdict_class supported. Issuing at tier 2 as a disclosed contribution claim; the gap's tier_with is 3, so closing g-1-household-survey with the quarterly household water-use survey is what would raise this to the target.
